label: ORB-v3 (conservative, 20, OMat)
elements: Li, Be, B, C, Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S
notes: The 20-neighbour variant of orb-v3-conservative-inf-omat.  Truncating the neighbour list to a fixed count is orientation-dependent whenever neighbour distances are degenerate, which the icosahedral and close-packed substrates are full of, so the 20/inf pair isolates that effect in the equivariance and null-space probes.
